claim_reviews.subject: Indonesian answer “jas”

claim_reviews.conclusion: Correct: Malaysian “sut” denotes a coordinated garment set, including a men’s jacket and trousers.

claim_reviews.conclusion: “Formal suit” appropriately specifies the intended matching jacket-and-trousers sense, but it exposes the mismatch with Indonesian “jas.”

response.rationale: “Sut” correctly denotes a matching suit in Malaysian Malay, but Indonesian “jas” primarily denotes the formal jacket, not the complete matching jacket-and-trousers suit. The Indonesian answer should be “setelan jas” (or equivalent), so the proposed contrast and sense are materially misleading. No genuine false-friend contrast is established; this is mainly a scope distinction.
